package handlers_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	transport "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
)

type t14PublicReader struct {
	calls             int
	studentID, pathID string
}

func (r *t14PublicReader) GetLearningPathByID(_ context.Context, studentID, pathID string) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error) {
	r.calls++
	r.studentID = studentID
	r.pathID = pathID
	if studentID != "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222" || pathID != "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" {
		return domain.StudentLearningPath{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: pathID, StudentID: studentID, CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{ID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", ReferenceType: "lesson", ReferenceID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", LessonRevisionID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", LessonContent: json.RawMessage(`{"title":"frozen","excerpt":"","description":"content","tasks":[{"answer_key":"private"}]}`)}}}, nil
}

func TestT14PublicAssignedContextRegisteredAuthenticationAndOwnership(t *testing.T) {
	const endpoint = "/api/v1/student/learning-paths/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/items/44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444/lesson-context"
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, actor, role, url string
		status, calls          int
	}{
		{"student", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "STUDENT", endpoint, 200, 1},
		{"student pro", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "STUDENT_PRO", endpoint, 200, 1},
		{"unauthenticated", "", "", endpoint, 401, 0},
		{"teacher role", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "TEACHER", endpoint, 403, 0},
		{"foreign owner", "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", "STUDENT", endpoint, 404, 1},
		{"foreign path", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "STUDENT", "/api/v1/student/learning-paths/77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777/items/44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444/lesson-context", 404, 1},
		{"foreign item", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "STUDENT", "/api/v1/student/learning-paths/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/items/77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777/lesson-context", 404, 1},
		{"invalid path", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "STUDENT", "/api/v1/student/learning-paths/bad/items/44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444/lesson-context", 400, 0},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			reader := &t14PublicReader{}
			router := transport.NewRouter(transport.RouterDependencies{AnswerHandler: &handlers.AnswerHandler{}, StudentLearningJourneyHandler: &handlers.StudentLearningJourneyHandler{AssignedLessons: studentuc.AssignedLessonContext{Paths: reader}}})
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, tc.url+"?student_id=77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", nil)
			request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", tc.actor)
			request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", tc.role)
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
			if response.Code != tc.status || reader.calls != tc.calls {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d calls=%d body=%s", response.Code, reader.calls, response.Body.String())
			}
			if tc.status == 200 {
				var body domain.AssignedLessonContext
				if json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &body) != nil || body.StudentID != tc.actor || body.Content.Title != "frozen" || response.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
					t.Fatalf("bad context %s", response.Body.String())
				}
				if len(response.Body.Bytes()) > domain.AssignedLessonContextMaxBytes {
					t.Fatal("wire cap exceeded")
				}
			}
		})
	}
}
